q: The variational principle connects topological and measure-theoretic entropy by:
opts: h_top(f) = sup_μ h_μ(f) (supremum over all f-invariant measures)
h_top(f) = h_μ(f) for the unique invariant measure μ
exp: Variational principle (Goodwyn, Dinaburg, Bowen): h_top(f) = sup_{μ∈M_f(X)} h_μ(f). The supremum is achieved by the measure(s) of maximal entropy (MME). This is the deepest connection between topological and ergodic theory.
